Issue Description: Simulator down due to TNB power failure and unable to engage vibration when we try to power up the sim
ActionTaken: [Mar 31 2016  2:38PM] [Haziq Shah] [ The power outage caused the network communication between the vibrationcabinet and the MCLPC to fail. We tried multiply attempts to restore thecommunication with no success.  Usingsteps from STEP1 KbID: 11015 we were able to re-establish communication but oneof the drives (Drive Y ), the EtherCAT device did not have Field Bus ID definedproperly.  Even though the address lookedcorrect it was corrupted within the drive. This normally results in the BusSecond Address retaining a 0 (0x0000) even after performing resetting the driveprocedure.  Through the Kollmorgen WorkbenchGUI I was able to select the drive Y and reset the fieldbus using the GUITerminal. Once wehad all the drives up and communicating the next step was to figure out why theVibration panel wasn’t able to Reset the E-stop error. After trouble shootingthe circuit we suspected the safety relay to be the source of the problem. Weran a couple different test to prove that the relay was the source of the problemand the test confirmed that. After replace the safety relay 24V AC/DC 5A P/N325848025611 S/N P5325838-02,issue resolved and sim back to normal afterreload. Issue Closed - Rusdi/Haziq]

Windows able to boot up  Partition D able to be detected.3) With initial setup condition, boot up the OPS   rack out P2  P4 after windows is booted. At the PROMISE shown the status changed from Green to RED. Check My Computer,  both Local Disk successfully detect. This shows the mirroring process is success.4) Insert back P2  P4  check the LED status at PROMISE software. It changes from  RED to GREEN.5) Force P2  P4 offline  rack out P1  P3. Perform reboot  windows operating system not found appeared after BIOS.6) By swapping the position between P2  P1, between P4  P3, reboot the OPS  the windows able to run successfully. However, on the PROMISE (Configuration), the P2  P4 shows DEAD Status. Perform rebuild process.Conclusion:1) The RAID C able to boot up the windows even there is no physical drive C. It can be used to perform mirroring process (rebuild) with the new HDD. However, the abnormalities of the HDDs will only be detected if both physical  logical drives are corrupted. 4) Using PROMISE software, rebuilding process takes longer time which is approximately 4 hours compared to actual backup  restore which only 2-3 hours.5) If the dead HDD is swapped to other trays, the PROMISE will always detect it as dead statusSuggestion when to use PROMISE Software:1) After performing cold start, SSE can check the status of the HDDs.
